attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion. Exactly TWO inputs: Image1 original small card is sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light and crop; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only. Only human anatomy becomes smooth golden-yellow compact NEAR-ROUND mascot head/body, green-ringed black eyes, source-matching mouth. Preserve real source hair, brows, conditional facial hair, clothes. ROUNDED CHIN immediately meets raised/broadened existing neckline, VERY SHORT BROAD neck transition and minimal throat exposure. No separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping or cream belly bib. Preserve actual NAVY naval garment fastening and limited pale inner collar/dark neckwear area, coherent front/rear collar overlap/contact shadow. Retain complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its exact original color and attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces opaque, alpha only outside complete card silhouette. No invented insignia/text/accessories. Fine primary details indistinct stay understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Three-quarter/near-PROFILE facing IMAGE-LEFT in Image1. DARK NAVY/BLACK peaked cap with broad GOLD decorative band/front motif and dark visor; short GREY/BROWN temple hair and real brow HAIR. Smooth upper lip/chin with serious CLOSED mascot mouth, no separate moustache/beard or glasses. DARK NAVY naval uniform with a narrow WHITE/GREY inner shirt/collar strip and small DARK neckwear area actually exposed, much front hidden by note; retain small source-visible muted GOLD/BROWN fitting patch low beside note without inventing its engraving. Keep the actual garment fastening, no invented wide business-suit lapels or extra shoulder orders not visible in Image1. Preserve primary head roll, cap angle, shadow and crop.
Preserve actual source head angle, garment details and expression. One compact near-round head with a clearly ROUNDED chin immediately contacting raised broad collar; no elongated lower-face V or neck shaft. Source-visible small fittings/color patches must not be silently replaced by generic buttons or plain cloth. Keep genuine primary microdetail uncertainty, no invented engraving. Image1 exact original; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
